tickets.title: Verify cash distribution readiness
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before initiating or approving Soren Velvetreed's cash distribution:
- Confirm requested gross or net distribution amount: $85,000 initial Teacup Comet Bank checking transfer and $9,000 monthly transfer after setup
- Confirm source account and available cash: Joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody ($1.18M as of August 19, 2026, including $73,000 cash, $280,000 municipal-bond ladder, and $310,000 of Copper Firefly Robotics stock)
- Confirm destination instructions are already authorized or identify required authorization steps: Teacup Comet Bank checking (destination account ending to be confirmed separately)
- Review tax withholding election or required withholding rules: Not applicable for this taxable-account distribution
- Check for potential trading, liquidity, margin, or settlement constraints: Possible municipal-bond ladder or Copper Firefly Robotics share sales may be needed to fund the request
- Confirm whether the distribution affects the financial plan, income strategy, or required minimum distribution tracking: Review against household recurring spending of about $14,200 per month and the September 2026 start of Soren's $9,500/month Copper Firefly Robotics consulting arrangement
- Document client authorization and method received: [AUTHORIZATION METHOD]
- Note final processing status and confirmation details: [STATUS]
tickets.evidence: The agreed August 27, 2026 follow-up is to review Soren’s requested $85,000 Teacup Comet Bank checking transfer and $9,000 monthly transfer after setup, including available cash, possible municipal-bond ladder or Copper Firefly Robotics share sales, and any planning impact.
